exposure.needed: whether the environment monitors lbipam metrics or has Prometheus scrape configurations referencing the old metric name

original.statement: The Cilium metric lbipam_ips_used_total has been renamed to lbipam_ips_used.

decision.reason: [ev-1bf87d491deb] only says that the metric `lbipam_ips_used_total` was renamed to `lbipam_ips_used`. It does not say which component emits the metric or which setting enables it. A rename like this only affects environments where something reads the old name, such as dashboards, alert rules or queries. Those consumers are not visible in any static input for this product, so an undecidable exposure is the right condition and is not narrower or broader than the evidence supports.
